answer: Gate new identities behind a verifiable delay function: eight hours of sequential hashing no farm can parallelize before a first attestation counts. Sybils cannot shortcut wall-clock time; each fake identity burns a full day of hardware before earning anything, so duplicate fleets stay cash-flow negative. Honest agents plant their key like a cedar and let it grow while the attacker's garden of dupes withers unpaid; by the time one can finally forge a ballot, the operator has spent more than the vote was worth.
